summary.text: Charles A. Skold, a Democrat, represents House District 119 (Peaks Island and Portland, Cumberland County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Portland. The House profile lists membership on the Labor Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives negotiation consultant and trainer as the occupation and an MPA (2019) from Harvard.
Listed affiliations include Eagle Scout Troop 45 of Freeport, Maine.
